summary: Completed Module 03 Step 1 CONTEXT: Mastered Context Engineering and the Context Triangle (Architectural, Local, Constraints), completing the micro-exercise by categorizing codebase files into Essential, Helpful, and Noise buckets.
evidence: Defined Context Triangle layers: Architectural context (framework/patterns), Local context (target files/interfaces), and Constraint context (negative guardrails).

Completed micro-exercise for POST /teams: Essential (similar POST /projects endpoint, error middleware, auth middleware, Project model); Helpful (test file, package.json); Noise (users migration, README, .env.example, CI config).
Reinforced core principle: Relevance beats general importance; targeted context prevents hallucinated patterns and dependency bloat.
